interpretation.before: metric v3; unchanged harness, default OS timer; all failures retained; adapter guard derived numerically because v3 did not serialize a pass flag
interpretation.after: metric v4; immutable archive GC isolation, bounded source queue, linked causal timestamps; Windows timer request1ms in benchmark process only
interpretation.comparable: same source/config/windows/repeats/models/recorder, same heartbeat20ms and additional5ms; legacy data age additionally preserved
interpretation.not_identical: new data age uses last actually applied symbol input, not next input; source delivery has explicit bounded queue. Timer profile differs and is declared, not a launcher change.
interpretation.admission: conditional local performance only; default-profile and live networking admission not established; label100ms is stricter than250ms adapter budget
